name: Hyperforce All-Stars! Volume 1
source:
Where Chaos Rains! Hyperforce All-Stars!

Join J5 the Hyperforce, Marik Ishtar (from Yu-Gi-Oh The Abridged Series) and Shuffle da Hyperforce as they go out to a party arranged by My Little Pony's Pinkie Pie and Vinyl Scratch. J5's personal hell starts when he finds out that many of his crushes have shown up to the party! With a cousin that wants to help him get laid, his Rival: Marik Ishtar causing hysteria with Yami Bakura and a bunch of Girls as far as the eye can see, This is one party you don't wanna miss!

[From [url=https://j5-the-hyperforce.itch.io/hyperforce-all-stars-stories-volume-1] itch.io[/url]]
